description: This file is a CMake module script that defines a function 'compile_aidl' for generating source code from AIDL files during build time. It contains detailed comments and documentation about how to use the function and how the AIDL compile process works, but no actual classes or functions are defined in the typical programming sense; instead, it defines a build helper function.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function that generates source files from AIDL files during build time, with configurable options for AIDL binary location, language, include directories, and target directory.
